. “These are not ad hominem attacks. We made them because Sardar Patel has also become a brand as Nepotism Buster of the parties,” spokesperson Sambit Patra said. The party organized an all-night brainstorming session on Saturday following a family meeting in the morning. Last year, when Prasad called Rahul Gandhi 'Pappu', it led to brainstorming becoming a standard practice.
The continuous noise regarding the land deal involving Vadra's suspected irregular transactions kept the Centre occupied as government departments probed.
Ministers deemed the accusations unfounded, stating that Vadra had previously been under inquiry, yet the electorate had still chosen him for office, and he was now being probed by several agencies.
A commerce ministry official said, “The objective seems to be to spread confusion by trying to suggest that some questionable incidents are related to Vadra as owner of real property and not just to another person who holds directorship and is merely providing right assistance as three others claim...” The official insisted that the whatsapp message is circulating in a questionable form. “It’s not even establishing an online or serial connection it seems.” The official said, “There is no actual basis even to address it.” Ministers stated that the issue concerned real property acquisition under the law and thus should be handled in accordance with those regulations.
Congress asserts that the issue was investigated previously when Vadra, as a director alongside another individual, was involved with a limited company.
Congress general secretary Randeep Surjewala stated that a three-member committee from the joint parliamentary committee or JPC was submitting its report with "facts" regarding Robert Vadra’s financial activities, alleged land acquisition issues, alleged misuse of government choppers for luxury trips, and Union minister Smriti Irani’s forged certificates.
“It’s a matter of the police followed it and it’s currently in front of the departmental internal audit committee.” However, a minister stated that the government and the Modi government were not nearly as ineffective on the issue as alleged.
